technique_name: Suggest a way to improve recycling practices
description: One way to improve recycling practices is to implement deposit refund programs. This involves consumers paying a refundable deposit when purchasing a product, which they can later receive back when they return the item to a recycling center. This incentivizes people to recycle since they have a financial incentive to do so. This type of program has been proven to be effective in increasing recycling rates.
